digest.component_or_area: HLC (Hybrid Logical Clock) implementation and environment configuration
propositions: The REBAR_HLC=0 environment variable is expired and no longer needed after multiple releases, yet the implementation at src/rebar/_store/hlc.py still honors it, creating risk of causal-ordering errors under skewed clocks
Removing the HLC disable branch requires migrating two compaction integration scenarios to use forward-ordered REBAR_HLC_NOW injected timestamps instead of disabling HLC

The seam guard in test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py tracks REBAR_HLC read-via markers and must reduce _MARKER_BUDGET for _store/hlc.py from 2 to 1 and _TOTAL_MARKER_CAP from 5 to 4 upon removal
Generated environment documentation and mechanism-baseline.json must remove all references to REBAR_HLC while retaining REBAR_HLC_NOW as the sole test-time physical-clock override

All removal consumers including HLC unit tests, store-path tests, and documentation must be updated to validate legacy event reads and deterministic clock behavior work without the disabled raw-clock branch
